# ToolsBoXMachine (TBXM) — Full Documentation

## Overview

ToolsBoXMachine (TBXM) is a free, open-source collection of browser-based utility tools. Every tool runs entirely client-side — no data is sent to any server. Built for privacy, speed, and simplicity.

**Maintained by:** RackRunner
**Source:** https://github.com/RackRunner1/ToolsBoXMachine
**License:** Unlicense
**Domain:** https://www.tbxm.org

## Tools

### Blur Image
- **URL:** /tools/blur/blur.html
- **Description:** Protect privacy by blurring sensitive parts of images
- **Category:** Image Editing
- **Client-side:** Yes
- **Input:** Image file (local)
- **Output:** Blurred image (downloadable)

### Calculator
- **URL:** /tools/calculator/calculator.html
- **Description:** Perform basic arithmetic calculations
- **Category:** Productivity
- **Client-side:** Yes
- **Operations:** Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division

### Password Generator
- **URL:** /tools/password-gen/password-gen.html
- **Description:** Generate secure passwords or passphrases
- **Category:** Security
- **Client-side:** Yes
- **Options:** Length, character types, passphrases

### QR Code Generator
- **URL:** /tools/qr-gen/qr-gen.html
- **Description:** Create custom QR codes for any link or text
- **Category:** Utility
- **Client-side:** Yes
- **Input:** URL or text
- **Output:** QR code image (downloadable)

### JSON Formatter
- **URL:** /tools/json-formatter/json-formatter.html
- **Description:** Format, minify, and validate JSON data
- **Category:** Developer Tools
- **Client-side:** Yes
- **Features:** Pretty-print, minify, validate, error detection

### Base64 Converter
- **URL:** /tools/base64/base64.html
- **Description:** Encode and decode Base64 strings
- **Category:** Developer Tools
- **Client-side:** Yes
- **Operations:** Encode text to Base64, decode Base64 to text

### Pomodoro Timer
- **URL:** /tools/timer/timer.html
- **Description:** Stay focused with timed work sessions
- **Category:** Productivity
- **Client-side:** Yes
- **Features:** Custom durations, break intervals, notifications

### Emoji Keyboard
- **URL:** /tools/emoji-keyboard/emoji-keyboard.html
- **Description:** Browse and copy emojis with one click
- **Category:** Utility
- **Client-side:** Yes
- **Features:** Search, categories, click-to-copy

### Notes
- **URL:** /tools/note/note.html
- **Description:** Create, save, and manage notes
- **Category:** Productivity
- **Client-side:** Yes
- **Storage:** localStorage (no server)
- **Features:** Create, edit, delete notes

### Clock
- **URL:** /tools/clock/clock.html
- **Description:** Display the current time
- **Category:** Utility
- **Client-side:** Yes
- **Features:** Real-time clock display

## Technical Details

- **Rendering:** Static HTML + vanilla JavaScript
- **Hosting:** Cloudflare Pages (static site)
- **No frameworks:** Pure HTML, CSS, JS — no React, no build step
- **Privacy:** All data processed in-browser via localStorage
- **Accessibility:** Responsive design, keyboard navigable

## Machine-Readable Endpoints

| Endpoint | Format | Description |
|---|---|---|
| /tools/index.json | JSON | Full tool catalog with metadata |
| /seo/sitemap.xml | XML | Sitemap for search engines |
| /llms.txt | Text | LLM-friendly site summary |
| /robots.txt | Text | Crawl rules and bot permissions |
| /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json | JSON | Task-specific skill index |
| /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json | JSON | MCP tool definitions |
